title: fix(cli): the compiled plugin manifest filename is the runtime's constant
body:
domain:server#2 · os-project-manager · session_0186vfjHHMsRXC9EUT9hTFMo

<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-project-manager"} -->
_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1XAzrBawWCXDWe5RxPWMYpti)_

Fixes #28080

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**：CLI 里插件清单文件名 `MANIFEST_FILENAME` 不再自己写一遍字符串，直接取运行时的 `COMPILED_PLUGIN_MANIFEST_FILE`。为了不让 `os plugin` 每条命令多花约 1 秒加载整个运行时，运行时新开一个只含这个常量的轻量子路径 `@objectstack/runtime/compiled-plugin-manifest-file`。
- **为什么改**：卡 #28080：`os plugin build` 写入、`publish`/`install` 完整性检查豁免用的文件名，和运行时读取用的文件名是两份手抄的同一字符串，一旦漂移，build 出的包运行时找不到清单。
- **风险与回滚**：文件名本身不变（`objectstack.plugin.json`），已构建的插件包照常可读；只是新增一个子路径导出。回滚即 revert。
- **先看**：`packages/cli/src/utils/osplugin.ts`（常量改为引用）；`packages/runtime/package.json` 与 `tsup.config.ts`（新子路径）；`packages/adapters/hono/vitest.config.ts`（为新子路径补的一条测试别名）。
- **两分钟验证**：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli exec vitest run --project unit test/osplugin-manifest-filename.test.ts` → 2 passed；把 osplugin.ts 里那行改成别的字面量，同一命令转红。
- **需要你做的**：无，席位落地。

## What changes

`MANIFEST_FILENAME` in `packages/cli/src/utils/osplugin.ts` was a hand-kept twin of `COMPILED_PLUGIN_MANIFEST_FILE` in `packages/runtime/src/compiled-plugin-manifest.ts`. It is now `export const MANIFEST_FILENAME = COMPILED_PLUGIN_MANIFEST_FILE`, imported from the runtime, so the entry `os plugin build` writes (`build.ts`), the entry `os plugin publish` and `os plugin install` exempt from the integrity map, the entry `computeIntegrity` leaves out, and the entry `readCompiledPluginManifest` finds are one name. The tree now holds one `'objectstack.plugin.json'` literal for it. `MANIFEST_FILENAME` stays as an alias because ten CLI test files and three command files import it.

**Import path, measured.** The constant was not reachable from any published runtime entry: `@objectstack/runtime` published only `.`, and its root `index.ts` did not export it. Importing the root entry from `osplugin.ts` is the heavy path that file's own header already refuses (`readOspluginManifest` imports the runtime on call for this reason). Measured on this box, three fresh `node` loads each:

| import | ms |
| :--- | :--- |
| `@objectstack/core` (osplugin.ts already imports it) | 335, 344, 355 |
| `@objectstack/runtime` root | 1447, 1388, 1363 |
| built `packages/cli/dist/utils/osplugin.js` after this change | 450, 417, 447 |

So the constant moved into its own import-free module, `packages/runtime/src/compiled-plugin-manifest-file.ts`, published as the subpath `@objectstack/runtime/compiled-plugin-manifest-file` (new `tsup` entry, new `exports` key with `import`/`require` conditions, matching the root entry's shape). `compiled-plugin-manifest.ts` imports and re-exports it, so the runtime's own readers and tests are unchanged. The runtime has no lean-entry gate of its own (`check:lean-entry-closure` guards `@objectstack/objectql/core` only); the module's header says it must stay import-free.

**Hono test alias.** `check:test-source-alias` resolves every published subpath through every vitest alias table. `packages/adapters/hono/vitest.config.ts` maps bare `@objectstack/runtime` by prefix to a mock FILE, which would have sent the new subpath to `src/__mocks__/runtime.ts/compiled-plugin-manifest-file` (ENOTDIR). The gate's remedy is applied: an anchored entry for the subpath ahead of the prefix entry, pointing at the runtime source. The comment there that said the runtime publishes only `.` is corrected. This file is outside the claim's declared file surface; it is a forced consequence of the new subpath (see Acceptance notes).

## Tests

`packages/cli/test/osplugin-manifest-filename.test.ts` (unit tier):

- `MANIFEST_FILENAME` is `COMPILED_PLUGIN_MANIFEST_FILE` (the runtime's constant, imported from the new subpath), not compared to a literal.
- An archive whose manifest entry is named `MANIFEST_FILENAME` is read `ok` by the runtime's `readCompiledPluginManifest`, and `computeIntegrity` leaves exactly that entry out.

**Ablation** (head `9c90f75a`, the implementation committed first): `node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` replaced `export const MANIFEST_FILENAME = COMPILED_PLUGIN_MANIFEST_FILE;` with `export const MANIFEST_FILENAME = 'objectstack.plugin.drifted.json';` (anchor 1 → 0, blob `89db86b4` → `76a05359`). Both cases red: `expected 'objectstack.plugin.drifted.json' to be 'objectstack.plugin.json'` and `expected false to be true`. Restored: blob back to `89db86b4` = the HEAD blob, `git diff HEAD` empty. The test imports `osplugin.ts` from source, so no build sits between the mutation and the run.

## Acceptance notes

- The triage line says the CLI imports the constant "from the runtime". It does, from a new runtime subpath rather than the root entry, because the root costs about a second on every `os plugin` command (table above). The order anticipated "export the constant from a new entry". A home in `@objectstack/core` (which already holds the artifact tar reader both sides share) would avoid the new subpath and the hono alias line; it was not taken because it departs from the triage ruling.
- Claim file surface: `packages/adapters/hono/vitest.config.ts` was added (one alias entry and a comment fix), forced by `check:test-source-alias` once the subpath exists. The seat may amend the claim's surface.
- `test/plugin-publish-manifest-entry.test.ts` still mocks a drifted `MANIFEST_FILENAME` to prove publish's manifest read does not depend on it. That drift can no longer happen in the real tree; the test stays because it still pins publish's single decode. Not touched.
- `MANIFEST_FILENAME` also names the SOURCE manifest `os plugin build` reads from the project directory (`build.ts`). That was already the same string, so nothing changes; noted because the alias now ties the source name to the runtime constant too.
- Commit trailers follow the repo's model-free pair (`check:commit-card-trailers` refused the first push; the tip was reworded before it was published).

## Verification

Final head `ce89ca90`. Local, per `.claude/agents/os-dev.md`:

- `pnpm --filter '@objectstack/cli^...' build`, then `pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime build` (new entry emitted: `dist/compiled-plugin-manifest-file.{js,cjs,d.ts,d.cts}`; `check-dts-emitted: 4/4`), `pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli build`.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli typecheck` and `pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime typecheck`: exit 0 (test layers held in their debt files).
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli exec vitest run --project unit --maxWorkers=2`: 361 files, 5152 tests passed. The integration tier is declared to CI (no integration file or spawn entry touched).
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime test`: 498 files passed, 8084 tests passed, 19 skipped.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/hono test`: 14 files, 231 tests passed.
- New subpath loads under both conditions from `packages/cli`: `require(...)` and `import(...)` each answer `objectstack.plugin.json`.
- Derived gates (`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack`, 76 commands on head `ce89ca90`): 74 exit 0, including `check:test-source-alias`, `check:published-files`, `check:dts-closure`, `check:type-check-debt`, `check:undeclared-dep-imports`, `check:lean-entry-closure`, `check:adr-0087-registration`. `check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test` needed its anchor commit fetched on this shallow clone, then exit 0.
- The other two read every package's build output and first answered exit 3 (`PREREQUISITE NOT MET` / `COULD NOT MEASURE`, nothing measured). After `turbo run build` over `./packages/**` and `./examples/**` (78/78 tasks), both exit 0: `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` (114 require entry points across 70 packages load, the new subpath among them) and `check:i18n-coverage` (14 configs, none new). So all 76 derived gates exit 0 on `ce89ca90`.
- Hand gates: `check:commit-card-trailers` 0, `check:nul-bytes` 0, `eslint --no-inline-config packages/cli packages/runtime packages/adapters/hono` 0.

## Human Minimum

- [x] 1. Schemas start as Zod; `packages/spec` holds no runtime logic. (`packages/spec` not touched.)
- [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind.
- [x] 3. No formatter ran; `pnpm lint` passes. (Scoped to the touched packages; the repo-wide run is CI's.)
- [x] 4. One issue, one branch off an up-to-date `main`, one pull request.
- [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset, and both declaration lines are filled in here and in the changeset. (`.changeset/28080-one-manifest-filename.md`: `@objectstack/cli` and `@objectstack/runtime` `patch`.)
- [x] 6. `packages/spec` touched: n/a.
- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`.
- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English. (The maintainer brief is in Chinese by the agent contract.)
